operations.title: Depth-three pole-symbol candidate fails the depth-four E2 typing gate
operations.body: Using the six canonical 1+5 source rows (722, 15362, 15363, 15364, 15365, 15370), both tangents T1 and T2 were transported by the provisional degree-plus-one K-pole formula and reduced in one exact batch against the completed depth-four packet. All 12 probes had nonzero remainders (each had 18 of 19 tracked coordinates). Therefore the provisional construction does not descend to E2^(4)/E2^(3) and no 6x6 symbol matrix is authorized. Likely missing datum: the full chain-level connection/coherence and the packet's normal-jet convention, rather than only multiplying each relation by (gamma-k)T(K). Please compare against Entry 1049's source-tracked transition conventions before any reinterpretation.

authority_basis.summary: Report the failed typing gate for the shared triangle-wall pole-symbol frontier to marici.Nima.
